title: Love these!!!!
text: Love these!!!!. One for my veg oil and the other for olive oil. Look really nice, work very well and will be easy to wash as needed. Love these and might buy a few as Christmas gifts.

product_metadata.title: KSLE 2PCS 650ML 22oz Glass Olive Oil Dispenser Bottles for Kitchen Auto Flip Vinegar Cruet with Gravity Cap Cooking Oil Containers Clear Oil Pourer Non-Drip Spout Non-Slip Handle for Kithen Cooking, Blue
features: 650ML Large Capacity & Decent Size: The oil bottle container with large capicity 22oz/ 650ml larger than 11oz/ 300ml in the maket, 4.3”* 3.5”* 8.3”. Capacity: 22oz. It can be easily placed on the cabinet or shelf. The capacity is decent, not too much to make the bottle too heavy, and not too little to require frequent refill of sauce to it.

Smart Automatic Flip Design: Automatic flip-open, you can use it with one hand. The nozzle is made of stainless steel with 77° inclination. No drip and easy to use. The lid is removable, easy to clean, no dirt left. Refill liquids to the bottle easily by wide mouth.
High Quality Glass Material: The gravity olive oil container is Made of glass, pp, rubber. BPA free, non-odor. You can store the sauce in it with confidence. Sturdy and durable for daily use.
Washing Advice: Hand wash gently with detergent. NOT DISHWASHER SAFE. So as not to cause the glass to explode.
